t: Crossgen comics | CBR Community
s: June 30, 2023 - Yeah, I used to page through the CrossGen titles -- and was always a fan of Sears, but couldn't quite jump on the CG ship. I think I have one or two issues of the First, but it's been a long time. Mystic looked good as well, but again - never tried it. I did pick up an issue or two of Sojourn. I do miss those Indy universes/comics from the 80s -- and CG was a decent attempt at bringing those back.
